subject: forklift
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: forklift.mdl, in the place of the game's models/forklift.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/sat_globe.mdl, models/fungus.mdl, models/bm_leg.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 3 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, B, B where the asset was C, C, A: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline reads as a warehouse forklift in every view: a mast of two uprights and an overhead guard at the front, a driver seated behind the mast, a white body with a red lower chassis and a white rear counterweight, four wheels, and forks at floor level. Front, left, back and right views agree, with no part sticking out or missing. The brief gives only the words 'forklift with its driver in the seat', and the outline matches them.

M2.reason: Measured size 186.6 x 60 x 113.4 against the brief's 187 x 60 x 113: each dimension is within 0.3%, well inside 15%.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies, down to the small ones: driver with yellow hard hat and green overalls, in the seat; steering wheel and seat; two mast uprights; overhead guard with four posts and a roof; two forks; a carriage plate; four wheels; a white hood and counterweight; the red chassis band with lettering. All are there in the side and angle views, in their places. The forks are thin and needle-like, which reads as tines at this size, but both are present and attached, so nothing is missing.

M4.reason: Regions read as the right materials: white painted metal body, red painted chassis, dark metal mast and forks, dark mesh roof, green cloth overalls, yellow plastic hard hat. Nothing is in a clearly wrong colour or material. The brief sets no colour, so this is judged on material reading.

M5.reason: Markings are there in their places: lettering on the red base in the side views, a number stamp on the white side panel, panel lines on the hood and the driver's face and clothing. Sharpness is a little soft at this scale, which is the same as the Valve lineup prop beside it.

M6.reason: Capped by the line-up test, as instructed. In the four-way line-up (asset at C, beside the sat globe, fungus and bm_leg), the judges picked the portal globe at B three times out of three, not the forklift, so the asset passes as one of the game's.

M7.reason: Front is the front: the mast and forks lead, the driver faces forward. The forks lie along the floor line at the wheel bottoms in the left and right views, so the model stands upright on its wheels and forks as a forklift does.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. Triangles are 749, the same as the most Valve spends on a model of its kind and size (749), so it is not past that bound. The overhead guard, forks, mast and wheels all join the body in the side and below views. Nothing visible is open, inside out or floating. The underside is open, but a player never sees it, which the rubric allows.
